newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait issues tender for oil gathering center.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait issues tender for oil gathering center.

text.p: Kuwait has invited 24 pre- qualified Western and Asian firms to participate in a tender to build a crude oil gathering center, the official gazette said.
The gazette did not give a value for the state's Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) tender which closes on December 15 and issued on October 13. The center will be built in northern Kuwait.

Last December KOC signed a $391.5 million, 27-month deal with China Petroleum Engineering Construction Corporation to build two crude gathering centers in Western Kuwait to increase production capacity by 410,000 bpd.
Kuwait, which has an OPEC quota of two million barrels per day (bpd), is seeking to increase production capacity to three million bpd by the year 2000, officials earlier said.
The new tender carries gathering center number 25 but several such centers were destroyed during the 1990-91 Gulf crisis. The deal with the Chinese firm is for gathering centres numbers 27 and 28.
